calendar: pinned XNYS has no regular session on UTC decision date; Saturdays, Sundays and NYSE holidays
context: Coinbase completed daily candles, crypto headlines and macro headlines; read-only FOMC archive; no Yahoo, equity/ETF prices, equity news, SPY/QQQ or EDGAR
models_and_retries: unchanged two independent analysts and reviewer, serial, same per-role retry rules
budgets: same durable per-UTC-day run, role, aggregate and source banks as weekdays; no separate allowance or refund

labels.price: exact Coinbase one-minute candle open, observable after minute completion; missing anchors remain pending

execution: ia_crypto only, consensus, UP long or flat, market gtc immediately after successful decision; all v2 caps, kill switch, idempotency, reconciliation, order budget and expiry guards retained
execution_registration: explicit operator-approved weekend_registration journal event binds this spec, preregistration, unchanged execution spec and grants before any weekend order; never replaces existing ledger bindings
exits: existing hourly :30Z crypto exit timer; at or after fixed label exit anchor
recovery: daily recovery timer explicitly skips closed-day crypto recovery with durable RECOVERY_WEEKEND_CRYPTO_SKIPPED alert; no new call or catchup reservation
scores: all analyst, reviewer, consensus, baseline and cohort scores in separate weekend_crypto_v1 population; no pooling into weekday scores, climatology or primary sample
limitations: actual paper entry differs from fixed research entry anchor
unavailable anchors and exhausted source budgets stay pending
production authorization expires 2026-11-05; no automatic renewal
